about: Breathing air is compressed air prepared to breathing quality, with controlled oxygen content and very low moisture, oil and contaminant levels. It is used in breathing apparatus, confined-space entry, fire and rescue training and diving support. Standards such as EN 12021 are commonly referenced.
Never use ordinary industrial compressed air, or a cylinder of another gas, for breathing. Ask us for the specification before ordering for safety-critical use.
